def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        if all(v == 0 for v in grid[r]) and any(any(v != 0 for v in grid[i]) for i in range(r)) and any(any(v != 0 for v in grid[i]) for i in range(r + 1, h)):
            out[r] = [3] * w
            return out
    return out
PY
